what: The Savings Circle Calculator plans a rotating savings group, often called a ROSCA. Members pay the same amount every round, and each round one member receives the whole pot until everyone has had a turn. Around the world it is called a committee or BC, tanda, susu, chama, hui, gameya, kye, or a chit fund.

Type the number of members, the amount and how often you pay, and the tool shows the payout per round, the total each member pays and a dated schedule of who receives the pot when. You can use the list order, reverse it or draw a random order.
Share the schedule as WhatsApp text, copy it, print it or download a PDF with a signature column. Names stay on your device.
uses: Agree on the amount, length and order before anyone pays.
Pick a fair random order and share it with the group.
Send the dated schedule to the group chat.
A sheet with a signature column for each payout.
See how many members or a different amount changes the pot and duration.
tutorial: Name the circle and choose a currency
A name is optional and appears on the shared text and PDF.
Type how many members there are (2 to 100) and how much each pays per round.
Choose how often you pay (monthly, every 2 weeks, weekly or daily) and the date of the first payout.
Type one name per line. Members without a name are called Member 1, Member 2 and so on.
Use the list order, reverse it, or pick Random draw and press Draw again for a new order.
If your group pays the organiser, type the fee per round; it is taken from each payout.
Press Share on WhatsApp, Copy text, Print or Download PDF.
features: Pot per round, total paid per member and number of rounds.
Monthly, fortnightly, weekly or daily, with month-end dates handled correctly.
Shuffle the order and redraw any time.
A clean text schedule ready for the group.
With a signature column for each payout.
Optional fee taken from each payout.
Names are saved only on your device.

example.title: Worked example: 10 members paying 100 a month
example.text: Each month all 10 members pay 100, so the pot is 1,000 and one member receives it. Over 10 months each member pays 1,000 in total and receives 1,000 once. If the first payout is on 21 Nov 2026, the last is on 21 Aug 2027. With an organiser fee of 50 per round, each payout is 950.

tips: Write down the rules: amount, dates, order and what happens if someone pays late.
Do the random draw with everyone present or on a video call.
Only join circles with people you trust; there is no bank protection.
Send a reminder a few days before each payment date.
problems: It says to enter 2 to 100 members
Type a whole number of members from 2 to 100.
You listed more names than members. Raise the number of members or remove names.
Your browser may block pop-ups. Use Copy text and paste it into the chat.
